name: Negativity
overview: Scripture instructs believers to avoid negativity by ceasing contentious behavior before it escalates, as strife begins like water being let out (Proverbs 17:14). Christians are called to live and walk in the Spirit, which fosters a mindset focused on what is true, pure, and praiseworthy rather than on harmful thoughts (Galatians 5:25; Philippians 4:8). Gratitude to God in all circumstances counters a negative spirit (Ephesians 5:20), while maintaining respect and submission to spiritual leaders helps preserve unity and prevent grief caused by divisiveness (Hebrews 13:17; Titus 3:10).
